name: Shifting Front
install:
export PATH="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v22.22.2/bin:$PATH"
set -euo pipefail
node -v
yarn install --frozen-lockfile
yarn playwright install --with-deps chromium webkit
start:
export PATH="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v22.22.2/bin:$PATH"
set -euo pipefail
if (echo >/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/3000) >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "dev server already listening on port 3000"
  exit 0
fi
exec yarn dev --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port 3000
